source.metadata_use: Count descriptions and target-region multiplicity only; do not run or score any selector.

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first three eligible scenes.

post_admission.algorithm: Unchanged SC21 TaskRelationalFunctionalSelector plus fixed parent-normalized connected-component integrity.

forbidden_after_metadata_access: inspect selector output during source admission
select scenes by wrong-part reduction or integrity outcome
claim_boundary: Outcome-blind SceneFun3D source admission for a fresh SC21 transfer check. Target-region identities and selector outputs are not used for scene ranking. Passing admission does not establish algorithm success, RGB proposal generation, reachability, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
